container.note: the engine reads only .jlm containers of exactly this version; anything else is converted with `jitllm convert`

input_formats.name: gguf
input_formats.note: a GGUF of an architecture in architectures; its tensor types must be in quantization.dequantable

input_formats.name: gguf+mmproj
input_formats.note: a text GGUF and its vision projector, joined into one container; the projector must be in projectors

input_formats.name: safetensors
input_formats.note: a Hugging Face directory whose config.json class is in safetensors_classes; -q8 stores the matrices as Q8_0

input_formats.name: url
input_formats.note: an hf:// or https:// URL, downloaded into JITLLM_MODELS first

input_formats.name: jlm
input_formats.note: the only format the engine runs; a container of another version is refused with the convert command

verified.hardware: Xeon E5-2680 v4 and D-2123IT (AVX2, no VNNI)

backends.name: cpu-amd64-sse
backends.note: x86 below SSE4.1+SSSE3 refuses to open a model, naming the missing extensions

backends.name: hip
backends.note: built and gated offline (every kernel compiles for gfx90a, gfx942, gfx1030, gfx1100 and gfx1201 through comgr); not yet run on an AMD card -- the device gates (TestHIPDeviceRunsTheIR) skip without one. An AMD card without ROCm runs through vulkan. See docs/design/amd-hip.md

refusals.when: presence_penalty is non-zero
refusals.message: presence_penalty is not supported

refusals.when: frequency_penalty is non-zero
refusals.message: frequency_penalty is not supported

refusals.when: n is outside 1..128
refusals.message: n must be between 1 and 128

refusals.when: top_logprobs is outside 0..20
refusals.message: top_logprobs must be between 0 and 20

refusals.when: a tool is not {type: function} with a name
refusals.message: only {"type": "function"} with a name is supported

refusals.when: tool_choice names a tool the request does not declare
refusals.message: which is not among the request's tools

refusals.when: a list of prompts with stream
refusals.message: a list of prompts cannot be streamed

refusals.when: logprobs with echo
refusals.message: logprobs with echo would need the prompt's own

refusals.when: logprobs or n with a list of prompts
refusals.message: logprobs and n with a list of prompts are not built

refusals.when: encoding_format is neither float nor base64
refusals.message: is not one of

refusals.when: dimensions is below 1
refusals.message: dimensions must be at least 1

refusals.when: max_tokens is absent or not positive
refusals.message: max_tokens is required and must be positive

refusals.when: speculative decoding with logprobs
refusals.message: speculation with logprobs is not built

refusals.when: speculative decoding with n above 1
refusals.message: speculation with several choices is not built

refusals.when: n above 1 with jitllm_session
refusals.message: several choices run on fresh sessions of a model

refusals.when: a forced tool call (tool_choice required, any or named) with ignore_eos
refusals.message: a forced tool call ends its reply with an end-of-generation token

refusals.when: response_format json_object or json_schema with ignore_eos
refusals.message: a grammar ends its reply with an end-of-generation token

refusals.when: the model is not an embedding model
refusals.message: is not an embedding model

refusals.message: which this server does not take

refusals.when: a document content block
refusals.message: is a document block, which this server does not take

refusals.message: a request carries at most
